perTrust._note: Girls' education runs through Swami Vivekanand Trust + Maa Shardamani Trust jointly; the headline girls figure (studentsGirls) is the unique count across both. Exact figures confirmed by the trust owner 2026-09-04: Swami Vivekanand Trust 7,200 students (1,000 who stayed at SVT only + 6,200 who continued on to Maa Shardamani), Maa Shardamani Trust 7,000 students (the same 6,200 who continued from SVT + 800 who came to Maa Shardamani directly) => unique girls = 1,000 + 6,200 + 800 = 8,000 exactly. Boys run through Gyanyogi Adhyatm Kendra: 631 students confirmed the same day (₹57 L; the ₹1.64 Cr previously shown on that page was an error, unrelated to Maa Shardamani's own ₹1.64 Cr).
